canonical_title: Cohere and Aleph Alpha sign definitive merger agreement
treatment: Repeat only for regulatory approval, closing, material financial changes, product roadmap integration, or compute deployment details.
known_facts: Cohere and Aleph Alpha signed a definitive merger agreement.
The combined company will retain the Cohere name with Toronto and Berlin headquarters.
Schwarz Group will invest 500 million euros and plans up to 13 billion euros of compute investment through StackIT.
The transaction remains subject to regulatory approvals.
